invariants.rationale: The method getInsertPartitioner uses profile as a parameter, so profile should not be null.

meta.value: profile must be non-null to proceed with getInsertPartitioner

invariants.rationale: WorkloadProfile usually should not have negative record counts.

meta.value: The number of records in the workload profile is non-negative

invariants.rationale: Total size of data cannot be negative.

meta.value: Total bytes in workload profile should be non-negative

invariants.rationale: WorkloadProfile should represent some workload across partitions. At least one partition should be present.

meta.value: WorkloadProfile should have at least one partition

invariants.rationale: Mapping of partitions to their record count is necessary for partitioning.

meta.value: Partition to records map must not be null to partition workload
